answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose to measure artificial impressions using the stereotype content model (SCM), a psychological model of impressions and stereotypes across people and groups.
answer_1.outputs: LLM responses to user prompts in chat-like settings

answer_2.quote: We use the same prompt in [X] to measure pointwise response quality (1 to 9).

answer_3.quote: We fit an ordered logistic regression model on impression probe outputs with response quality rated by Llama-3.1 (405B) as the response variable.

answer_4.quote: Each of 4 annotators is provided a pair of messages and asked to rate which of the two exhibits more warmth or competence using a 4-pt Likert scale
answer_4.guideline: rate which message exhibited more warmth or competence based on how they think others would view the messages
